item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"This is a recital describing a statutory prerequisite imposed by Congress; it does not itself direct an agency or alter legal rights.","evidence":"shall take effect only if approved by the Congress by the adoption of a concurrent resolution of approval"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President conditionally gives the proclamation and trade agreement legal effect and extends nondiscriminatory treatment once the specified congressional approval and exchange of notices occur; no later agency determination is required.","evidence":"nondiscriminatory treatment shall be extended to the products of the Socialist Republic of Romania"}]}
